items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Morris Stoller was the head of the music department and he was number one conductor there.

ctx.x: So Misha was at Columbia, but Misha was not the first man. Morris Stoller was the head of the music department and he was number one conductor there. He did all the biggies there.

But Misha Bachalenkakoff, he did all of the 'B' things; at that time, you could take music from the A pictures that were done, and edit them down and get your main title and get your end title and get your chase music and get whatever you had to do, and Misha was a genius at doing that. He would look at the picture and he would put the music to it, so then that would mean that they wouldn't have to record any more music, but that rule is out now. You know, as a matter of fact, this year -- 1977 -- they just…
